name: town-buildings
mood: Northstar Town, a cozy lakeside company town on a bright spring morning. Each building is a charming, handcrafted diorama piece with real materials: warm brick, painted clapboard, cedar shingles, slate and terracotta roofs, white window frames with glowing warm glass, flower boxes, brass lamps. Cohesive, storybook, premium — never generic or plain. Every building is clearly readable at a glance as what it is.

items.prompt: Northstar HQ: the town's grand civic headquarters, three storeys of cream limestone and pale sandstone with a slate-blue hipped roof, a central clock pediment with a round white clock, a flagpole on the roof ridge with a red-and-gold flag, tall white-framed sash windows in neat rows on every storey, a columned portico with four white columns and wide stone steps around the entrance. The front entrance (double doors, taller than a person) is in the MIDDLE of the lower-left facing wall. Window boxes with red geraniums. Dignified, bright and welcoming.

Tidewater Café: a cozy lakeside café, warm peach-cream stucco walls with honey-oak trim, a steep terracotta tile gable roof with a brick chimney, a red-and-cream striped awning along the lower-left facing wall over big warm-lit shop windows, a glass-paned café door in the MIDDLE of the lower-left facing wall, a hanging wooden sign bracket with a coffee cup emblem (no text), strings of little lanterns under the eaves, flower boxes and a chalkboard easel by the door. Inviting, European, golden.

Pixel Pier Arcade: a playful retro boardwalk arcade, violet and deep indigo painted wood with pink and cyan neon tube trim along the edges, a flat roof with a big ornate marquee sign frame covered in chasing light bulbs (no letters), round porthole windows glowing pink, a wide open entrance with double glass doors in the MIDDLE of the lower-left facing wall under a bulb-lit canopy, a little star weathervane. Joyful, glowing, a bit seaside.

The Quiet Grove: a peaceful log cabin retreat in the woods, honey-brown log walls, a mossy green shingled gable roof with a stone chimney, small warm-lit windows with wooden shutters, a covered wooden porch with a rocking chair and hanging lanterns along the lower-right facing wall, the wooden front door in the MIDDLE of the lower-right facing wall, ferns and mushrooms at the base. Calm, hushed, woodland.

Engineering Studio: a modern two-storey workshop studio, pale grey fibre-cement panels with warm timber cladding bands, a flat roof with a row of blue solar panels, sawtooth skylights and a small antenna with a red light, big factory-style steel-framed windows with teal-lit glass on both storeys, a roll-up glass garage door and a glass entrance door in the MIDDLE of the lower-right facing wall, a bike rack and planters by the entrance. Smart, crafted, humming.

Design Loft: an artsy two-storey converted brick loft, butter-yellow painted brick with coral window frames, a steep coral-red gable roof with a big north-light studio skylight, tall arched windows full of plants, climbing green ivy over one corner, a small balcony with an easel, a coral front door in the MIDDLE of the lower-right facing wall with a round window above it. Creative, colourful, charming.

Launch Lab: a sleek two-storey mission-control lab, bright white panels with bold orange stripes and navy trim, a flat roof carrying a small radar dish and a slim launch tower with a tiny orange-and-white rocket model, porthole and ribbon windows glowing blue, a round-topped hangar-style entrance door in the MIDDLE of the lower-right facing wall with a countdown light above it. Optimistic, space-age, clean.

Lantern Hall: the town's festive event hall, rich terracotta-red brick with cream stone trim, a tall plum-purple slate gable roof, a grand front with four cream columns and a triangular pediment, tall arched windows glowing warm gold, strings of paper lanterns in many colours draped along the eaves, the grand double entrance doors in the MIDDLE of the lower-left facing wall under a small marquee canopy of bulbs. Celebratory, warm, a little theatrical.
